## Section Three
Code to implement lyrics into top_songs table
```{r student3}
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(geniusr)
library(rvest)

token <- "0KNA5jy240qJr8BgPvw31HQVe6sJgKFemi4Old3f6l5CN04wbwmThZHIuHHR_7xM"

geniusr::genius_token(token)

clean_text <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    str_to_lower() %>%
    str_remove_all("\\(.*?\\)") %>%   # removes (feat. ...) etc.
    str_remove_all("[[:punct:]]") %>%  # removes quotes, commas, apostrophes
    str_squish()
}


get_lyrics <- function(title, artist) {
  tryCatch({
    
    query <- paste(title, artist)
    res <- search_genius(query)
    
    if (length(res) == 0 || length(res[[1]]) == 0) return(NA)
    
    url <- res[[1]][[1]]$url
    
    page <- read_html(url)
    
    lyrics <- page %>%
      html_nodes("div[data-lyrics-container='true']") %>%
      html_text() %>%
      paste(collapse = " ")
    
    if (lyrics == "") return(NA)
    
    lyrics
    
  }, error = function(e) NA)
}

top_songs <- top_songs %>%
  mutate(
    lyrics = map2_chr(title, artist, get_lyrics)
  )
```

## Section Four

```{r student4}

```

Testing code for web scraping

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(janitor)

years <- 1958:2025

get_top_song <- function(year) {
  url <- paste0(
    "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Billboard_Year-End_Hot_100_singles_of_",
    year
  )
  
  page <- tryCatch(read_html(url), error = function(e) return(NULL))
  if (is.null(page)) return(NULL)
  
  tables <- page %>% html_table(fill = TRUE)
  if (length(tables) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  df <- tables[[1]] %>% clean_names()
  
  # Title column patterns
  title_col <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "(title|song|single|track)")]
  
  # Artist column patterns
  artist_col <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), "(artist)")]
  
  # If either is missing, skip this year
  if (length(title_col) == 0 | length(artist_col) == 0) {
    message("Skipping year ", year, " — could not find title/artist columns")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  top <- df %>% slice(1)
  
  tibble(
    year   = year,
    title  = top[[title_col[1]]],
    artist = top[[artist_col[1]]]
  )
}

top_songs <- map_df(years, get_top_song)
top_songs
```
